evidence.text: There is not a book where it details you how to take care of your child, even if there is one it would probably not be as helpful as you learning each day.

If there were a class of "How to be a mother for the first time if you are a teen" it would not cover all the expectations that you baby requires because you will be the only one that knows your baby, its behavior and what its needs are.
Even adult mothers have said that they keep learning how to be mother everyday.
